notes: Connects to a camera's ONVIF metadata stream over RTSP (channels 1-4) and prints each analytics event as it arrives: feature, True / False state, rule, and the fields you choose (ObjectId, Action, Speed, Count, or your own).
Filters by feature, state and rule; Pause (Space) stops printing so you can read, and marks how many events the pause skipped.
Double-click a timestamp to copy that event's metadata XML; double-click a feature to see it, colour-coded, with a picture of it on the clipboard.
Event statistics per feature, with average rates and Enter / Exit counts; RTP packet-loss and memory charts for long sessions.
Saves event logs, bestshot images and metadata per camera if you want; reconnects by itself when the stream drops.

Updates: Help > Check for updates, and an automatic check once a day that can be turned off in Settings > General. Update now downloads the new version and restarts, keeping your cameras, settings and saved data.
Camera passwords show as *** in the event log and in logs\debug.log.
